name: claude-google-ads
description: End-to-end Google Ads operator for ECOMMERCE advertisers (any niche/brand — retail, wholesale, DTC): setup, conversion-tracking validation, account audit, launch planning, per-type campaign builders (Search, Branded Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen), safe push, monitoring, and ongoing optimization.
